schema: Dynamically bound by answer_schema to exact public target IDs, types, units, frames and physical query times; no original assets replaced.
prompt: Answer the immutable public physical question concisely. Return plain_text_answer and exactly one typed entry for every public answer_spec target. Copy each target binding exactly. physical_forecast is a separate autonomous model prediction, never ground truth. When present, use its named numeric channels at the requested physical time to inform the numeric answer; do not alter the supplied forecast. When absent, make your own public-information-only numerical estimate or return unsupported with a reason. Boolean outputs are controlled exclusively by output_readout: reproduce every supported Boolean exactly, and every unsupported Boolean as status unsupported, value null and a reason. Never invent a Boolean, contact force, event or value for an unsupported target, including in prose. Explain unsupported components explicitly. Do not silently omit targets. Distinguish sampled rule-derived outcomes from numerical forecasts and your own answer. The event readout uses a 0.02-second sampled grid with no interpolation; it cannot recover exact continuous-time events or duration breaks between samples. Never claim access to private reference trajectories or gold answers. No fallback or schema repair is performed. Supported values require reason null; unsupported values require value null and a nonempty reason.
